title: "Buy now, pay later" gives holiday shoppers a new option
summary: CBS Mornings segment profiles a satisfied Affirm user alongside an analyst's caution that BNPL's ease can encourage more spending.

assertions.quote: a firm underwrites each transaction separately in real time
they pay higher fees to a firm because consumers often spend more
there's a difference between buy now pay later and buy now pay never

verdicts.note: CFPB: lenders that restrict a borrower's ability to remove autopay 'benefit from increased payment "stickiness" to keep credit losses below a desired threshold' -- a policy choice that protects the lender's own loan book rather than the borrower.

assertions.quote: remember with bnpl's disciplined spending managing your credit smartly still falls primarily on you
